title: DuoCook: An Overcooked-Inspired Benchmark for Visual Planning and Coordination
title_zh: DuoCook：一个受Overcooked启发的视觉规划与协作基准

paragraphs.en: Coordinating two players in a cooking task requires a vision-language agent to track changing scene states, sequence recipe steps, and allocate shared resources under a time budget. We introduce an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for evaluating these capabilities in Unreal Engine environments constructed using coding agents. A single vision-language model controls both players from top-down visual observations, selecting high-level actions while the engine executes navigation. The benchmark contains 20 maps in five categories. These categories support evaluation of centralized coordination under equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies. A prop legend and pot ingredient-count indicators provide explicit visual cues, while grid-based destinations support spatial grounding. The evaluation compares four VLMs on all 20 maps, measuring task score, order completion, delivery precision, action acceptance rate, and model API expenditure. A memory ablation on the same 20 maps examines the effect of a shared, self-authored notebook while retaining six-response action history in both conditions. The strongest evaluated model, gpt-6-astra , achieves 26.2% mean order completion. Notebook memory has mixed score effects across models, with positive mean differences for Claude and Qwen and negative differences for GPT and Gemini.
paragraphs.zh: 在烹饪任务中协调两名玩家，需要一个视觉-语言智能体在时间预算内跟踪不断变化的场景状态、安排食谱步骤的先后顺序，并分配共享资源。 我们推出一个受 Overcooked 启发的基准，用于在借助编码智能体构建的 Unreal Engine 环境中评估这些能力。 单个视觉-语言模型基于俯视视觉观测同时控制两名玩家，选择高层动作，而由引擎执行导航。 该基准包含五个类别的 20 张地图。 这些类别支持在装备争夺、地形变化和交接依赖下评估集中式协调能力。 道具图例和锅内食材数量指示器提供了明确的视觉线索，而基于网格的目的地则支持空间定位。 评估在全部 20 张地图上比较四个视觉-语言模型，衡量任务得分、订单完成率、交付精度、动作接受率以及模型 API 开销。 在同样 20 张地图上进行的记忆消融实验考察了共享的自写笔记本的影响，同时两种条件下均保留六次响应的动作历史。 受评估的最强模型 gpt-6-astra 达到 26.2% 的平均订单完成率。 笔记本记忆对得分的的影响在各模型间不一，对 Claude 和 Qwen 带来正向均值差异，对 GPT 和 Gemini 则为负向差异。

paragraphs.en: A cooking task can fail even when individual actions appear sensible. A player may chop the correct ingredient while blocking a board needed for an urgent order, or wait beside a boiling pot instead of working elsewhere. Efficient cooking requires tracking unfinished operations, assigning complementary work, and revising schedules as equipment and ingredients become available. This raises a broader question: can a vision-language model (VLM) use visual observations and structured task information to coordinate interdependent work under order deadlines?
paragraphs.zh: 烹饪任务即使在每个动作看起来都合理的情况下也可能失败。 玩家可能切着正确的食材，却占用了紧急订单所需的案板，或者守在沸腾的锅旁而不去别处干活。 高效烹饪需要追踪未完成的操作、分配互补的工作，并在设备和食材变得可用时调整计划。 这引出了一个更宽泛的问题：视觉语言模型（VLM）能否利用视觉观察和结构化任务信息，在订单截止时间的约束下协调相互依赖的工作？

paragraphs.en: We introduce DuoCook, an Overcooked-inspired benchmark in Unreal Engine where a single VLM controls two players from a shared context. Its 20 maps span five categories: basic, shared equipment, dynamic, dynamic with shared equipment, and separated workspaces (Section 3.2 ), introducing equipment contention, terrain changes, and required handoffs. The model assigns both players’ work to maximize delivery score under deadlines, time-dependent tips, and a streak bonus, making centralized coordination the evaluation target. Coding agents construct kitchens through SimWorld Studio ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , followed by manual refinement and actor-contract verification (Section 3.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DuoCook，这是一个受 Overcooked 启发、基于虚幻引擎的基准，其中单个 VLM 在共享上下文下控制两名玩家。 其 20 张地图涵盖五类：基础、共享设备、动态、动态与共享设备、分离工作区（第 3.2 节），引入了设备争用、地形变化和必要的交接。 模型需为两名玩家分配工作，以在截止时间、随时间变化的奖励和连击加成下最大化送达得分，使集中式协调成为评估目标。 编码智能体通过 SimWorld Studio（Kang et al., 2026）构建厨房，随后进行人工润色与角色契约验证（第 3.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation protocol combining five performance, action-validity, and API-cost metrics with an ablation of shared notebook memory.

paragraphs.en: Overcooked-AI studies coordination and cooperation with humans ( Carroll et al., 2019 ) , while ProAgent uses language models to infer teammate intentions ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) . MindAgent’s CuisineWorld supports centralized multi-agent scheduling ( Gong et al., 2024 ) , and Collab-Overcooked combines resource isolation, asymmetric knowledge, and communication to evaluate interdependent collaboration ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . DuoCook builds on these precedents with one visually grounded controller for both players and map variations that expose resource and spatial dependencies. It evaluates centralized scheduling rather than inference about an independently controlled partner; neither multi-cook control nor required handoffs alone constitutes its contribution.
paragraphs.zh: Overcooked-AI 研究与人类的协调与合作（Carroll et al., 2019），而 ProAgent 使用语言模型来推断队友意图（Zhang et al., 2024a）。 MindAgent 的 CuisineWorld 支持集中式多智能体调度（Gong et al., 2024），而 Collab-Overcooked 结合资源隔离、非对称知识和通信来评估相互依赖的协作（Sun et al., 2025）。 DuoCook 在这些先例的基础上，为两名玩家提供了一个视觉接地的控制器，并通过地图变化来暴露资源与空间依赖关系。 它评估的是集中式调度，而非对独立受控伙伴的推断；无论是多厨师控制还是必需的交接，单独都不构成其贡献。

(2025) examines asynchronous, long-horizon planning, while Cookbench Cai et al. (2025) combines recipe preparation with customer-intention recognition. Related planning benchmarks include WORKBENCH Qiao et al. (2025) and Plan-over-Graph Zhang et al. (2025b) for graph-structured workflows, AsyncHow Lin et al. (2024) for ordering tasks with known durations, and TimeArena Zhang et al. (2024b) for scheduling in an interactive environment. PACE Huang et al. (2026) overlaps planning and execution through interleaved reasoning and action. These directions inform DuoCook’s scheduling demands, such as preparing another dish while soup boils.

paragraphs.en: Balrog evaluates planning and exploration across games ( Paglieri et al., 2025 ) , while VisualAgentBench spans embodied interaction, graphical interfaces, and visual design ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . EmbodiedBench covers semantic tasks, navigation, and manipulation ( Yang et al., 2025 ) ; VideoGameBench evaluates raw visual gameplay, including a paused setting that separates some inference-latency effects from action selection ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . DuoCook focuses on matched interventions within cooking workflows. Its engine-executed navigation, grid labels, and structured state assist the controller, so scores are not directly interchangeable with those from different observation and control interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: Balrog 在多款游戏中评估规划与探索能力（Paglieri et al., 2025），而 VisualAgentBench 则涵盖具身交互、图形界面与视觉设计（Liu et al., 2025）。 EmbodiedBench 覆盖语义任务、导航与操作（Yang et al., 2025）；VideoGameBench 评估原始视觉游戏过程，包括一种暂停设置，该设置可将部分推理延迟效应与动作选择分离开来（Zhang et al., 2025a）。 DuoCook 聚焦于烹饪工作流程内的匹配式干预。 其由引擎执行的导航、网格标签和结构化状态为控制器提供了辅助，因此其得分无法与来自不同观察与控制接口的得分直接互换使用。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 summarizes the benchmark workflow, from kitchen construction to controller execution and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 总结了从厨房构建到智能体执行与评估的基准测试流程。

paragraphs.en: We construct kitchens in Unreal Engine using SimWorld Studio, which provides coding agents with Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and Markdown skills for scene configuration and asset placement. Two separate claude-opus-5 processes author the generation prompt and build the scene, respectively. The authoring process reviews the SimWorld Studio architecture, then receives the game context, a reference image, and an actor naming and scene-structure contract. It produces a construction prompt with a completion checklist covering required appliances and VLM-controlled MetaHuman characters. The construction process executes this prompt with access to the game context, pipeline code, actor contract, and reference image. We then refine the scene manually and run a script to verify required actors and their names. Manual edits address decoration, collisions, visibility, and camera configuration. In a truck scene, for example, we moved rocks clear of the truck bed, adjusted the top-down camera’s yaw, added an isometric camera, and removed a truck wall to expose the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 SimWorld Studio 在 Unreal Engine 中构建厨房，该工作室为编码智能体提供用于场景配置和资产摆放的模型上下文协议（MCP）工具与 Markdown 技能。 两个独立的 claude-opus-5 进程分别负责撰写生成提示词和搭建场景。 撰写进程先审阅 SimWorld Studio 的架构，然后接收游戏上下文、一张参考图像，以及角色命名与场景结构契约。 它生成一份构建提示词，其中包含覆盖所需电器和由 VLM 控制的 MetaHuman 角色的完成清单。 构建进程在可访问游戏上下文、流水线代码、角色契约和参考图像的条件下执行该提示词。 随后我们手动微调场景，并运行脚本验证所需角色及其名称。 手动编辑处理装饰、碰撞、可见性和相机配置。 例如在卡车场景中，我们把石块移离卡车车斗、调整俯视相机的偏航角、添加一个等距相机，并移除一面卡车侧壁以露出厨房。

paragraphs.en: All maps contain floors, counters, ingredient bins, pots, plates, chopping boards, and serving points. Bins, boards, and pots are fixed to counters, which block movement but support food and plate placement. Players move, carry and place objects, chop ingredients, plate food, and serve dishes. After serving, dirty plates appear in sinks for washing on sink-equipped maps; otherwise, clean plates reappear at their initial locations. The map categories vary the coordination required by these operations. Basic and shared-equipment maps have fixed terrain: the former allow independent order completion, while the latter require players to share stations such as chopping boards or pots. Dynamic maps introduce counters or floor sections that move back and forth every 1,000 steps, changing obstacles or traversable terrain; gaps remain inaccessible, preventing falls. Four dynamic maps require equipment sharing, and four do not. In separated workspaces, players cannot cross between regions and must pass ingredients or plates across counters, so neither can complete a dish alone.
paragraphs.zh: 所有地图都包含地板、台面、配料箱、锅、盘子、砧板和上菜点。 配料箱、砧板和锅固定在台面上，台面会阻挡移动，但支持放置食物和盘子。 玩家可以移动、携带和放置物品，切配料，装盘食物，以及上菜。 上菜后，在配备水槽的地图上，脏盘子会出现在水槽中等待清洗；否则，干净的盘子会在其初始位置重新出现。 地图类别改变了这些操作所需的协调程度。 基础地图和共享设备地图具有固定的地形：前者允许独立完成订单，而后者要求玩家共享砧板或锅等操作台。 动态地图引入了每 1,000 步来回移动的台面或地板区域，从而改变障碍物或可通行的地形；缺口仍然无法通行，防止玩家掉落。 四张动态地图需要共享设备，另外四张则不需要。 在分隔的工作空间中，玩家无法跨区域移动，必须隔着台面传递配料或盘子，因此任何一方都无法独自完成一道菜。

paragraphs.en: The controller receives kitchen images alongside task instructions, live state, legal operations, execution feedback, and six-response action history (Figure 2 ).

paragraphs.en: At each decision, both players share a top-down kitchen image with grid labels, a prop legend, and textual context (Figure 2 ). A map-specific system prompt of approximately 4,000 words provides kitchen rules and recipes, using the simulator’s menu, and is re-sent at every decision. Live-state reports player actions, positions, held items, and station claims, together with orders and preparation status. Game-UI information is supplied as text to reduce dependence on UI appearance. The engine lists legal operations based on kitchen state and station claims, without filtering by waiting orders; rejection feedback explains failures without suggesting corrective plans. Each player’s action history contains its six most recent responses, newest first, with actions, target cells, and execution acceptance. This history is retained in both experimental conditions. The memory-enabled condition additionally supplies a shared, self-authored notebook (Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在每次决策时，两名玩家都会获得一张带有网格标签的俯视厨房图像、一份道具图例以及文本上下文（图 2）。 一段约 4,000 字的特定于地图的系统提示词使用模拟器的菜单提供厨房规则和食谱，并在每次决策时重新发送。 实时状态报告玩家的动作、位置、持有的物品和站台占用情况，以及订单和准备状态。 游戏界面信息以文本形式提供，以减少对界面外观的依赖。 引擎根据厨房状态和站台占用情况列出合法操作，而不根据等待中的订单进行过滤；拒绝反馈会解释失败原因，但不提出纠正方案。 每个玩家的动作历史包含其最近六条响应，最新的在前，包括动作、目标单元格和执行是否被接受。 该历史在两种实验条件下均予以保留。 启用记忆的条件额外提供一个共享的、由智能体自写的记事本（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Each map has an N × M N\times M grid with coordinates rxcy , where x x and y y denote row and column. The origin is randomly assigned per map and then fixed; the controller reads image labels to locate targets (Figure 2 ). Commands pair a destination coordinate with an action, such as pickup, chopping, or serving. Station interactions target the station cell; the engine handles the approach using a navigation mesh (NavMesh) that excludes counters and gaps. Incompatible action-target pairs and unreachable destinations return errors for the controller to revise and retry. State-change events trigger VLM calls, including action or cooking completion, order arrival or expiration, and terrain changes. The engine updates observations and pauses simulation during VLM inference. When one player finishes, the controller assigns its next action while preserving the other player’s ongoing action, which resumes after inference. Terrain changes interrupt movement, prompting the controller to select a destination and action from the updated scene and the engine to plan a new route.
paragraphs.zh: 每张地图有一个 N × M 的网格，坐标为 rxcy，其中 x 表示行，y 表示列。 原点在每张地图中随机指定后固定不变；控制器读取图像标签以定位目标（图 2）。 命令将目标坐标与动作配对，例如拾取、切配或上菜。 站台交互以站台格子为目标；引擎使用排除台面和空缺的导航网格（NavMesh）处理行进路径。 不兼容的动作-目标对和不可达的目标会返回错误，供控制器修改并重试。 状态变化事件会触发视觉语言模型（VLM）调用，包括动作或烹饪完成、订单到达或过期，以及地形变化。 在 VLM 推理期间，引擎更新观察结果并暂停仿真。 当一名玩家完成后，控制器会为其分配下一个动作，同时保留另一名玩家正在进行的动作，该动作在推理结束后继续执行。 地形变化会中断移动，促使控制器根据更新后的场景选择目标地点和动作，并由引擎规划新的路线。

paragraphs.en: For each map, the initial state, number of orders, and order sequence are fixed and shared across models and memory conditions. Each model runs once on each of the 20 main-evaluation maps with memory enabled. For the ablation, we reuse those results on the same 20 maps and run each model once more on each of those maps with memory disabled. These settings match the starting conditions and order workload; subsequent trajectories depend on the model’s actions. We compute metrics for each episode and average them with equal weight across the 20 evaluation maps. Category summaries use only the evaluated maps in that category. For the memory ablation, we compute the difference between conditions on each of the 20 maps and then average these paired differences. With one run per model, map, and condition, results are descriptive and do not estimate variability across repeated model runs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每张地图，初始状态、订单数量和订单序列都是固定的，并在各模型与记忆条件之间保持一致。 每个模型在启用记忆的情况下，在20张主评估地图上各运行一次。 对于消融实验，我们在相同的20张地图上复用这些结果，并在禁用记忆的情况下让每个模型在这些地图上再各运行一次。 这些设置匹配起始条件和订单工作量；后续轨迹则取决于模型的动作。 我们为每个回合计算指标，并在20张评估地图上以等权重进行平均。 类别汇总仅使用该类别中经过评估的地图。 对于记忆消融实验，我们在20张地图中的每一张上计算各条件之间的差异，然后对这些配对差异取平均。 由于每个模型、地图和条件仅运行一次，结果仅具描述性，无法估计多次模型运行之间的变异性。

paragraphs.en: Commands are counted separately for each player, so a response assigning both players contributes two commands. Each retry counts as another issued command. Rejections include unreachable destinations and incompatible action–target combinations. Accepted commands remain counted even if they are later interrupted or do not advance an order. The metric therefore measures command validity under the supplied interface, while score and order completion measure task performance. Episodes with no issued commands are reported as N/A.

paragraphs.en: The shared memory is a notebook the two players fill in themselves. With any decision a player may attach up to three observations, each a tuple of grid cell, object kind, status, and an optional free-text note. Both players read the resulting table back on every subsequent call, rendered one row per observed cell, and each row carries the identity of whoever wrote it. Entries decay on an exponential forgetting curve with a 600-step half-life and are displayed in three confidence bands ( just seen , fairly sure , hazy ); hearsay from the partner decays twice as fast as first-hand observation. Nothing in it is validated against the simulator: it records beliefs, and a stale or mistaken row is part of what the condition tests.
paragraphs.zh: 共享记忆是一个由两名玩家自己填写的笔记本。 玩家在做任何决策时可以附带最多三条观察，每条观察是一个元组，包含网格单元格、对象种类、状态，以及一条可选的自由文本备注。 两名玩家在之后的每次调用中都会读取生成的表格，表格中每个被观察的单元格渲染为一行，且每行都标明了是由谁写入的。 条目按指数遗忘曲线衰减，半衰期为600步，并以三个置信区间显示（「刚看到」、「比较确定」、「模糊」）；来自队友的传闻比第一手观察的衰减速度快一倍。 其中的内容不会与模拟器进行验证：它记录的是信念，而过时或错误的条目正是该条件所测试的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Centralized two-player control leaves communication, private information, and adaptation to independent teammates outside the primary evaluation. Top-down observations and engine navigation reduce demands that would be present under first-person sensing or direct motor control. The prop legend, pot indicators, live-state JSON, and engine-computed legal-operation list provide additional information and assistance. Results therefore reflect planning under this combined interface, including selection among legal operations to advance waiting orders.
paragraphs.zh: 集中式双人控制将通信、私有信息以及对独立队友的适应排除在主要评估之外。 自顶向下的观察和引擎导航降低了第一人称感知或直接运动控制下原本会存在的要求。 道具图例、锅指示器、实时状态 JSON 以及引擎计算出的合法操作列表提供了额外的信息与辅助。 因此，结果反映的是在这种组合界面下的规划，包括在合法操作中进行选择以推进等待中的订单。

paragraphs.en: This paper develops the design of an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for visual planning and centralized coordination in agent-generated Unreal Engine kitchens. Its 20 maps span five categories covering independent work, shared equipment, changing terrain, and required item transfers. The evaluation protocol compares four VLMs on all 20 maps using task performance, action acceptance, and API cost, with a memory ablation on the same 20 maps. Experimental conclusions apply to this evaluated suite. This provides a concrete way to investigate how a controller turns visual observations into coordinated cooking actions.
paragraphs.zh: 本文设计了一个受 Overcooked 启发的基准，用于智能体生成的虚幻引擎厨房中的视觉规划与集中式协调。 其 20 张地图涵盖五个类别，包括独立工作、共享设备、地形变化和必需的物品传递。 评估协议在全部 20 张地图上比较四个视觉语言模型，采用任务表现、动作接受率和 API 成本作为指标，并在同样的 20 张地图上进行记忆消融实验。 实验结论适用于本评估套件。 这为研究控制器如何将视觉观测转化为协调的烹饪动作提供了一种具体途径。

paragraphs.en: gpt-6-astra achieves the highest mean score (25.6), order completion (26.2%), and action acceptance (64.6%), while Claude has the highest delivery precision among episodes with deliveries. Performance remains low, especially on dynamic maps with shared equipment and on separated-workspace maps. Shared notebook memory increases mean API cost for every model and has mixed score effects: Claude and Qwen improve in the observed means, whereas GPT and Gemini decline. These results describe one run per model, map, and condition; repeated runs are needed to assess the stability of these differences.
